name: package-lifecycle-scripts
displayName: Review Scripts That Run on Install
description: Blocks fetch-exec class hooks and asks about other new ones when a change adds or edits code that runs at install or build time: npm install/prepare/pack scripts, gypfile without native sources, bin shadowing, unpinned git/URL deps; setup.py cmdclass and import-time calls, .pth imports, conftest, pyproject build hooks; build.rs and build-deps; go:generate; MSBuild Exec; gemspec, extconf, Podfile, Composer, Maven, Gradle exec. Judges file text, not what a hook runs. Friction, not a security boundary. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo. In Cursor the turn's end is not held: a refusal there is handed back to the agent as a follow-up message, once, and a hook that fails to answer lets the turn end.]
